Pagination abuse with maximum first argument at every level. Bypasses depth limits by staying shallow while requesting enormous result sets.
Subscribe to order events requesting nested PII. Tests whether subscription resolvers enforce field-level authorization.
50 directives on a single field. Some GraphQL implementations process each directive sequentially, causing CPU exhaustion or stack overflow.
Subscribe to user creation events requesting sensitive fields. If subscription auth is weaker than query auth, may leak new user data in real-time.
Batched login mutations for credential brute-force. Sends 5 password attempts in a single HTTP request, bypassing per-request rate limiting.
Batched IDOR enumeration. Fetches 10 user emails in a single request. Bypasses per-request rate limits and may evade WAF.
